QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] The Truth Behind Kritias
QuestInfo.0: Relay the shocking truth of Kritias you heard from Cantor to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: Cantor tells you the shocking truth of Kritias: that it was Hekaton that made the pentacle. And about the mysterious Subject No. 618 as well as the disappearance of the king. How will Neinheart react?
QuestInfo.2: You relayed the truth behind Kritias to Neinheart.

0.0: You got a bit closer to the truth behind what happened in Kritias. It would be difficult to investigate further, so return to the Alliance.

yes.0: You mean to tell me what happened in Kiritas was because of King Hekaton?
yes.1: This is preposterous... The king would really go to such lengths in search of eternal life...?
yes.2: But if that's the case, perhaps the Black Mage went to Kritias because of this Subject No. 618 that King Hekaton was keeping hidden away.
yes.3: Hmm. It's best we keep this a secret. What's done is done and it will be difficult to investigate further if King Hekaton is gone.
yes.4: For the time being, we need to focus on the tasks before us. The truth will come to light in due time.
